patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Hides details about your phone from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Sends the app's network traffic through a proxy you choose, such as Orbot or a VPN service's SOCKS5 server.
Removes the ads in on-demand videos, the feeds, and articles.

sources.label: Patches for Android TV streaming apps
sources.author: TV
patch_list: Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Plays each video at its highest quality instead of lowering it to match the measured connection speed.
Hides details about your device from the app. Choose which ones in the patch options.
Stops the app from asking for, or requiring, an update from Google Play.
Removes the ads in on-demand videos and the ads shown when a video is paused.
